title: A Day of Irish Lottery Luck!
heading: September 25: A Day of Irish Luck
description: September 25, 2024, was a lucky day for Irish Lottery enthusiasts. Discover how players from Dublin, Mayo, Cork, and Limerick won millions.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Millionaire Dreams Come True

When it comes to luck, the Irish always seem to have an edge. On Wednesday, September 25, 2024, that reputation was in full force as winner after winner paraded to Lottery HQ.

Irish eyes were smiling as Lottery winners across the country cashed in on a total of €7,944,508 in prizes, with a handful of life-changing windfalls that had jaws dropping from Dublin to Cork.

Dublin’s Jackpot King

At the top of the pack was a Dublin man who struck gold with a massive €6,756,855 Lotto jackpot win from the August 17th Irish Lotto draw. After only realizing his good fortune a few days prior, he admitted, with a laugh, that he usually only buys tickets when the jackpot gets “really high.” This casual approach turned into a multimillion-euro payout that left him speechless.

“I saw an email that said I’d won over €100, and I thought ‘class!’ But when I opened the app and saw €6.7 million, I couldn’t believe it.”

“I was in complete denial until Martin from the Claims Department confirmed it. Surreal doesn’t even begin to describe it.” he shared, still in shock as he collected his prize.

Now, with millions in the bank, he’s taking things slow, planning to travel, share his winnings with family, and seek financial advice. No rush for this new millionaire!

Mayo’s Millionaire on a Roll

Not far behind was a lucky player from Mayo who cashed for €1,005,000 playing EuroMillions. His secret weapon? The National Lottery App’s which randomly generated numbers for a quick pick. The winner indicated he’d just won a holiday two days prior—clearly, this guy’s on a winning streak!

With a shiny new dream car and a luxury holiday on the horizon, he’s living proof that good luck comes in waves. “They say things come in threes, so maybe there’s more to come!” he laughed.

Cork and Dublin Join the Party

It wasn’t just Dublin and Mayo basking in their winnings — Cork and Dublin added to the magic of September 25 at Lottery HQ. A Cork winner scored €50,000 on a Scratch Ticket, while another Dublin player picked up a tidy €132,653 from the Irish Lotto.

The Luck Continues: Limerick Hits the Jackpot

But the Irish luck wasn’t limited to those visiting the National Lottery HQ. Another big win was in the making.

As the day’s winners celebrated, news broke that Limerick had its own reason to rejoice—a lucky player bagged the €5,501,086 Lotto jackpot in Wednesday night’s draw. This made them the seventh Irish Lotto Jackpot winner of 2024, adding yet another chapter to Ireland’s incredible lottery success stories.

Good Fortune and Good Causes

As Irish winners toasted their success, it’s also worth remembering that the National Lottery isn’t just about life-changing wins. Since the Lottery began, over €6 billion has been raised for Good Causes..

Ireland’s lotto luck was undeniable on September 25. Who knows? Take your Irish Lotto shot at Lotto Express and maybe next time the luck of the Irish will be yours!
